approved_scope: Owner-authorized Phase 2 trial only; RF-F003, RF-T005, RF-T006, RF-T007 unchanged. Phase 3 not approved.
description: RF-F003-based Phase 2 RF-T008 rev3: at most TWO composite IC var-C branches, each with a setting-common IC fixed C in parallel (hot-hot 0.2..3pF/Q60; hot-GND 0.5..3pF/Q60) and variable 0..3pF/Q35; fixed PCB-C grounded 0.02..1pF/Q60, non-ground 0.02..0.2pF/Q40, total max three. No old RF-T007 0.5pF/Q40 ground-DTC parasite. All other RF-F003 and T008 rev2 conditions retained.
validation_notes: RF-T008 revision3: Model EVERY installed IC variable capacitor branch as two separate passive parallel admittances on identical terminals (a,b). Choose a single setting-invariant fixed IC capacitor per branch: hot-hot/series/bridge Cfix in [0.2,3.0]pF Q60; hot-GND/shunt Cfix in [0.5,3.0]pF Q60. Independently choose 6 setting-dependent variable capacities Cvar in [0,3.0]pF Q35. Ctot is [0.2,6.0]pF hot-hot and [0.5,6.0]pF hot-GND. Treat Cfix and Cvar losses independently Y=omega*Cfix/(1/60-j)+omega*Cvar/(1/35-j). At Cvar=0 the fixed IC capacitor still exists; never model the series branch as an open circuit. Do not ADD the former RF-T008/Q40 shunt DTC 0.5pF parasitic (replaced by chosen Cfix Q60); that old parasitic stays only in separate RF-T007. IC-fixed C is tied to one installed DTC and not independently placeable. IC fixed C is not a PCB_PATTERN_C, consumes none of 3 PCB-C positions; provisional 0 additional chip area cost is NOT zero real silicon area. Fixed PCB_PATTERN_C limits stay grounded 0.02..1pF/Q60, non-ground 0.02..0.2pF/Q40, count total<=3. Variable C maximum 2 branches (0..2 installed), fixed IC C accompanies each installed DTC so also <=2; Q35, Cvar<=3pF, no composite 3pF upper cap; all fixed original external S2Ps, 50ohm source, 60-j40ohm load, six modes, 30dB mandatory H2/H3, 35dB nominal target, IL 0.3dB target, chip L/k, chip area objective unchanged. Do NOT merge RF-T006 3-6GHz requirement. Require explicit trial-aware stamping, pre-run EXP ID reservation, independent MNA, and new performance checks; old T008 numbers are historical, not validated for revision3; rev2's three-DTC result is not allowed as a rev3 candidate. Phase 2; no Phase 3.

previous_version.meaning: Previous Phase2 trial with fixed 0.5pF/Q40 grounded DTC-only parasitic; superseded in RF-T008, still available by Git history. RF-T007 remains unchanged.

previous_revision_2.meaning: Prior RF-T008 v2 used maximum three composite IC DTC branches; retained in Git history without retrospective change.
